text:
If you're still above 15 percent at 25, you're losing years.

At 12 to 15 percent body fat you look athletic. Face sharp, abs visible, veins show on your forearms.

Women who claim to like soft bodies? That preference disappears the second you're lean. Every single time.

The only time you go above 15 percent is during deliberate muscle gain.

Single digit body fat is overkill and requires performance drugs.

The target is 12 to 15 percent.

Soft men disappear. Lean men show. Four weeks and you're there.

Your face shows your self discipline before you even speak. That's your dating currency.
